newsitem.title: USA: Police search for missing Italian in Florida Keys.
newsitem.headline: Police search for missing Italian in Florida Keys.

text.p: Authorities continued their search on Wednesday for an Italian tourist missing for four days after an apparent boating accident in waters off the Florida Keys.
Davide Malloni, 25, whose hometown was not known, rented a powerboat for a fishing trip Saturday and was due back on Saturday evening, the Florida Marine Patrol said.
The boat was discovered, overturned, in the waters of the Florida Straits off Matecumbe Key on Sunday, but Malloni was not found, FMP officer Steve Acton said.
"Right now we're treating it as a boating accident," Acton said. "The weather was terrible out there Sunday."
"We really don't know if he's still alive," he said.
Investigators said there was a chance he might have survived and had obtained photographs from his family to circulate in case anyone had seen him.
